keywords: EIP-8141 frame 状态 gas 第二维度
summary: lightclient 把 frame 的 `gas_limit` 拆成 `execution_gas_limit` 和 `state_gas_limit` 并合并，执行 gas 仍是调用帧层面的概念，状态 gas 改按 frame 处理。另一组 PR 关注已迁移账户：EIP-8151 阻止撤销的 ECDSA 密钥通过 `ecRecover` 授权，而 EIP-8141 的 `SIGPARAM` 会在另一处重开这个缺口。Jochem Brouwer 的基准确认 Glamsterdam 重定价数值安全且最终。Eli Ben-Sasson 对 EF 放弃 Poseidon 的决定提出批评。

items.title: EIP-8141：为 frame 加入显式的状态 gas 第二维度
items.note: （lightclient）合并。把 frame 的 `gas_limit` 拆成 `execution_gas_limit` 和 `state_gas_limit`：执行 gas 仍基本是调用帧层面的概念，状态 gas 则按 frame 处理。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: add an explicit second dimension for state gas to frames
items.note_en: (lightclient), merged. It splits a frame's `gas_limit` into `execution_gas_limit` and `state_gas_limit`: execution gas continues to be (generally) a call-frame concept, while state gas is treated as a frame-level concept.

items.title: EIP-8141：限制 SIGPARAM 签名者内省仅用于空代码或委托代码的账户
items.note: （Marchhill）提交。EIP-8151 阻止已迁移账户被撤销的 ECDSA 密钥经 `ecRecover` 作为授权出示，而 `SIGPARAM(0x00)` 把 `resolved_signer` 交给 EVM 代码，消费方无法区分有效密钥和已撤销密钥。配套的 EIP-8151：写明已撤销密钥不变式 提交。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: restrict SIGPARAM signer introspection to accounts with empty or delegated code
items.note_en: (Marchhill), submitted. EIP-8151 stops a migrated account's revoked ECDSA key being presented as authorization through `ecRecover`, but `SIGPARAM(0x00)` hands `resolved_signer` to EVM code with no way for the consumer to tell a live key from a revoked one. The companion EIP-8151: state the revoked-key invariant was submitted.

items.title: EIP-8141：放宽禁用操作码列表
items.note: （Marchhill）提交。验证规则允许第一个 `deploy` frame 对 `tx.sender` 存储做 `SSTORE`，禁用列表却全面禁用 `SSTORE`，只给 `CREATE`、`CREATE2`、`SETDELEGATE` 例外，PR 补上对应例外。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: relax the banned opcode list
items.note_en: (Marchhill), submitted. The trace rules permit `SSTORE` to `tx.sender`'s storage inside the first `deploy` frame, but the banned list bans `SSTORE` outright while carving out `CREATE`, `CREATE2` and `SETDELEGATE`; the PR adds the matching carve-out.

keywords_en: EIP-8141 second state gas dimension for frames
summary_en: lightclient split a frame's `gas_limit` into `execution_gas_limit` and `state_gas_limit`, merged: execution gas stays a call-frame concept while state gas is handled per frame. Another set of PRs looks at migrated accounts: EIP-8151 stops a revoked ECDSA key from authorizing through `ecRecover`, but EIP-8141's `SIGPARAM` would reopen that gap elsewhere. Jochem Brouwer's benchmarks confirmed the Glamsterdam repricing numbers are safe and final. Eli Ben-Sasson criticized the EF's decision to drop Poseidon.
